label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 10: Omission of information on the right of withdrawal
2. If the trader has provided the consumer with the information provided for in paragraph 1 of this Article within 12 months from the day referred to in Article 9(2), the withdrawal period shall expire 14 days or, in cases where Member States have adopted rules in accordance with Article 9(1a), 30 days after the day upon which the consumer receives that information.
raw_output: This applies when a business sends information about the right to cancel to a customer after 12 months of the original purchase. The customer can cancel within 14 days, or 30 days if their country allows longer.
enrichment: This applies when a business sends information about the right to cancel to a customer after 12 months of the original purchase. The customer can cancel within 14 days, or 30 days if their country allows longer.
